# Velvet UI

> Glassy SwiftUI components with spring motion and haptics for iOS 18+ and macOS 15+. Frosted glass over solid neutral page tones, no borders, VoiceOver and Reduce Motion built in. MIT.

Add it with Swift Package Manager (https://github.com/MatiasPC/velvet-ui.git, product `VelvetUI`, from 0.2.0) and `import VelvetUI`, or copy a single component and the core it needs into your app with the CLI: download https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MatiasPC/velvet-ui/main/scripts/velvet.swift, then run `swift velvet.swift add <Name>`. Inject a `DSTheme` once at the root with `.dsTheme(DSTheme(style: .sunset))`, wrap screens in `DSScreen(backdrop: true)` for the glass look, use design tokens only (never raw colors, fonts or spacing), and read AGENTS.md first.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MatiasPC/velvet-ui/main/AGENTS.md): Read this first: rules, component chooser, tokens, copyable patterns and anti-patterns
- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MatiasPC/velvet-ui/main/README.md): Install (package or copy-in), quick start, theming and accessibility
- [docs/tokens.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MatiasPC/velvet-ui/main/docs/tokens.md): Every design token and its value
- [registry.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MatiasPC/velvet-ui/main/registry.json): Machine-readable registry of components, files, dependencies and docs

## Components

- [DSButton](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MatiasPC/velvet-ui/main/docs/components/DSButton.md): Text button with five variants, three sizes, an icon and a loading state.
- [DSIconButton](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MatiasPC/velvet-ui/main/docs/components/DSIconButton.md): Icon-only button with press scale, a haptic and a VoiceOver label.
- [DSSlideToConfirm](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MatiasPC/velvet-ui/main/docs/components/DSSlideToConfirm.md): Slide-to-confirm for payments and destructive actions, with an async result.
- [DSToggle](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MatiasPC/velvet-ui/main/docs/components/DSToggle.md): Switch with a spring knob and a rigid haptic.
- [DSRadioGroup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MatiasPC/velvet-ui/main/docs/components/DSRadioGroup.md): Single-select list whose indicator pops to the accent and whose highlight slides between rows.
- [DSStepper](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MatiasPC/velvet-ui/main/docs/components/DSStepper.md): Minus/plus stepper that ticks on every step and jiggles at its bounds.
- [DSRating](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MatiasPC/velvet-ui/main/docs/components/DSRating.md): Drag-to-rate stars, with half steps and a read-only mode.
- [DSSegmentedControl](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MatiasPC/velvet-ui/main/docs/components/DSSegmentedControl.md): Pill or underline picker with a sliding indicator.
- [DSTextField](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MatiasPC/velvet-ui/main/docs/components/DSTextField.md): Text field with label, icon and validation states, plus DSSearchBar.
- [DSCodeField](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MatiasPC/velvet-ui/main/docs/components/DSCodeField.md): One-time-code input with SMS autofill, a shake on error and success feedback.
- [DSPageControl](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MatiasPC/velvet-ui/main/docs/components/DSPageControl.md): Page dots whose active dot stretches into a capsule.
- [DSTabBar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MatiasPC/velvet-ui/main/docs/components/DSTabBar.md): Floating glass tab bar with a sliding accent capsule, a symbol swap and count badges.
- [DSCard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MatiasPC/velvet-ui/main/docs/components/DSCard.md): The glass surface everything sits on: elevated, outlined, flat, tappable or with an image.
- [DSListCell](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MatiasPC/velvet-ui/main/docs/components/DSListCell.md): List rows, section headers and dividers.
- [DSCarousel](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MatiasPC/velvet-ui/main/docs/components/DSCarousel.md): Snapping carousel with peeking neighbors and scroll-driven depth; pairs with DSPageControl.
- [DSSheet](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MatiasPC/velvet-ui/main/docs/components/DSSheet.md): Native sheet with Velvet chrome: detents, a grabber, a glass background and the theme carried in.
- [DSBadge](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MatiasPC/velvet-ui/main/docs/components/DSBadge.md): Status pills and count badges.
- [DSAvatar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MatiasPC/velvet-ui/main/docs/components/DSAvatar.md): Remote image with an initials fallback.
- [DSNumberTicker](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MatiasPC/velvet-ui/main/docs/components/DSNumberTicker.md): A number whose digits roll like an odometer, for any FormatStyle (currency, percent, grouping).
- [Charts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MatiasPC/velvet-ui/main/docs/components/Charts.md): Light animated charts: a sparkline that draws and morphs, and a bar chart you can scrub.
- [DSActivityRings](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MatiasPC/velvet-ui/main/docs/components/DSActivityRings.md): Concentric goal rings that fill with a spring and close with a glow and a haptic.
- [DSToast](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MatiasPC/velvet-ui/main/docs/components/DSToast.md): Success, error, warning and info toasts: present with .dsToast for auto-dismiss, replacement and flick-to-dismiss, announced by VoiceOver.
- [DSEmptyState](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MatiasPC/velvet-ui/main/docs/components/DSEmptyState.md): Icon, title, message and an optional call to action.
- [Progress](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MatiasPC/velvet-ui/main/docs/components/Progress.md): Circular, linear, multi-color and step progress, animated numbers, shimmer skeletons.
- [DSThinkingIndicator](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MatiasPC/velvet-ui/main/docs/components/DSThinkingIndicator.md): Ambient "thinking" state for AI and background work.
- [DSSkeleton](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MatiasPC/velvet-ui/main/docs/components/DSSkeleton.md): Loading placeholder blocks, plus .dsSkeleton(_:) to redact a real view in place.
- [DSSuccessCheck](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MatiasPC/velvet-ui/main/docs/components/DSSuccessCheck.md): An animated success seal: the ring draws, the check strokes in, one pop and a haptic on the beat.
- [DSTypewriterText](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MatiasPC/velvet-ui/main/docs/components/DSTypewriterText.md): Types phrases out character by character, with a blinking caret.
- [Motion](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MatiasPC/velvet-ui/main/docs/components/Motion.md): dsBreathe, dsJiggle, dsPopIn, dsEdgeSweep and dsHueDrift modifiers for any view.
- [DSConfetti](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MatiasPC/velvet-ui/main/docs/components/DSConfetti.md): A themed confetti burst from any point, fired whenever a trigger value changes.
- [DSScrollReveal](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MatiasPC/velvet-ui/main/docs/components/DSScrollReveal.md): A scroll-coupled reveal: rows and carousel cards recede as they cross the edge of the scroll view, reversibly.
- [DSMarquee](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MatiasPC/velvet-ui/main/docs/components/DSMarquee.md): Content that scrolls horizontally in a seamless loop, but only when it is too wide to fit.
- [DSChipGroup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MatiasPC/velvet-ui/main/docs/components/DSChip.md): Selectable pill chips for filters and tags, on a wrapping flow layout, with single or multiple selection.
- [DSFlowLayout](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MatiasPC/velvet-ui/main/docs/components/DSFlowLayout.md): Wrapping layout that flows items onto new rows when they overflow the width — tag clouds, filter chips, keyword lists.
- [DSHoldToConfirm](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MatiasPC/velvet-ui/main/docs/components/DSHoldToConfirm.md): Press-and-hold confirmation: a ring charges while you hold, with the same async result as slide-to-confirm.
- [DSSlider](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MatiasPC/velvet-ui/main/docs/components/DSSlider.md): Continuous value slider with a glass track, optional notches, tick and end-stop haptics, and VoiceOver adjust.
- [DSRangeSlider](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MatiasPC/velvet-ui/main/docs/components/DSRangeSlider.md): Two-knob range slider for filters (price, age, hours): knobs that never cross, an optional minimum gap, notch ticks and a firm stop at each limit.
- [DSLikeButton](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MatiasPC/velvet-ui/main/docs/components/DSLikeButton.md): A like / favorite / bookmark toggle: the symbol swaps with a replace transition, pops, and radiates one filled halo; optional rolling count.
- [DSKeypad](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MatiasPC/velvet-ui/main/docs/components/DSKeypad.md): Numeric keypad for amounts, passcodes and quantities: keys that dip and tick, the locale's decimal separator, and a wiggle for a key the value refuses.
- [DSTiltCard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MatiasPC/velvet-ui/main/docs/components/DSTiltCard.md): A glass card that tips in 3D toward the finger with a sliding specular sheen, then springs back.
- [DSDisclosureGroup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MatiasPC/velvet-ui/main/docs/components/DSDisclosureGroup.md): Glass accordion / FAQ row that springs open with a rotating chevron and a haptic.
- [DSTimeline](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MatiasPC/velvet-ui/main/docs/components/DSTimeline.md): A vertical progress timeline: nodes joined by a connector that fills as the flow advances. Order tracking, multi-step flows, activity history.
- [DSExpandableText](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MatiasPC/velvet-ui/main/docs/components/DSExpandableText.md): Long copy that collapses to a few lines and springs open, with a rotating chevron and a Show more / Show less toggle.
- [DSCheckbox](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MatiasPC/velvet-ui/main/docs/components/DSCheckbox.md): Checkbox whose box pops to the accent while its tick draws on, with a rigid haptic.
- [DSFlipCard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MatiasPC/velvet-ui/main/docs/components/DSFlipCard.md): Two-sided glass card that turns over in 3D on tap or from a binding, with a haptic and a Reduce Motion fallback.
- [DSAvatarGroup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MatiasPC/velvet-ui/main/docs/components/DSAvatarGroup.md): Overlapping facepile of DSAvatars with a +N overflow bubble, read by VoiceOver as one element.
- [DSAudioBars](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MatiasPC/velvet-ui/main/docs/components/DSAudioBars.md): An equaliser for live audio: bars that ripple while active, follow an optional level and rest flat when idle.

## Examples

- [Onboarding](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MatiasPC/velvet-ui/main/docs/examples/Onboarding.md): Example: paged welcome with a typed headline, a live theme picker, notification toggles and a success seal with confetti.
- [Settings](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MatiasPC/velvet-ui/main/docs/examples/Settings.md): Example: grouped glass rows with toggles and a segmented control, a Saved toast, and account deletion in a sheet with slide-to-confirm.
- [Checkout](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MatiasPC/velvet-ui/main/docs/examples/Checkout.md): Example: quantity steppers, a promo code, a rolling total, slide-to-pay with a declined-card path and a success moment.
